title: 第二十三章 红袖添香好读书第二十四章 暖床丫鬟
content_zh:
“世安刚回来，身旁也没个体己伶俐的丫鬟，这说出去也不像话，红袖、紫烟两个丫头服侍我多年，甚是得当，日后就跟在安儿身边，服侍安儿。”
行礼完毕后，镇北王妃看着白宣道。
话音落下，镇北王妃身后两个丫鬟走出。
一个一袭黑衣，肌肤雪白粉嫩，光滑晶莹，恍若上等的羊脂白玉一般，臻首轻垂，并不言语，显得很是温顺。
一个一袭紫衣，眉眼弯弯，身形娇小，约莫五尺，不过身材却显得很好，娇俏可人，有一种别样的反差感。
白宣好奇地多了眼黑衣女子，那穿紫衣的想来就是紫烟，但这红袖为什么不穿红衣啊？
不过这个念头方才涌现，当即反应过来镇北王和镇北王世子先后殒命，这丫鬟要是敢在这个时候穿红，怕是要被乱棍打死，念头一晃而过，白宣看向镇北王妃道：“多谢大娘了。”
不说作为未来的镇北王，便是镇北王府的公子，身边也少不了丫鬟下人。
既然要假扮许世安，做镇北王，那么这等红尘历练是少不了了。
长得都还行，养在身边，也算赏心悦目。
见白宣同意，镇北王妃颇为满意地点了点头，然后看向两个丫鬟道：“你们两人务必侍奉好公子。”
“是。”
红袖、紫烟两个丫鬟齐齐称是，自觉地站在了白宣的身后。
“妹妹好不容易回来一趟，今晚不如先和我一起睡。”镇北王妃又看向段白语道。
“今夜，我想陪着仲文。”段白语闻言，却是婉拒道。
多年不见，再次相见，却是天人永隔。
唯一的好处便是他先去了地下。
这样安儿去了地下，也不会被人欺负。
可若是有的选，都能在人间多好。
镇北王妃闻言，面色也是微微一变，拍了拍段白语的手，叹了口气道：“那便一起吧，最后见见仲文，安儿回来了，仲文的丧事也该下葬了。”

她们在镇北王还不是镇北王的时候，便认识了。
当时镇北王还只是个什么也不是的寒门子弟，一次意外见了她们姐妹俩，高呼“仕宦当作飞羽卫，娶妻当得段家女”。
当时，没人在意他，只当他是个口出狂言的少年郎。
只是谁能想到，学堂祭酒弑君，大周内乱，镇北王乘风而起，还真给他做到了。
嫁给镇北王，固然有家族利益的考量，但更多的是她们都爱镇北王。
段白语点了点头，反手握住自家姐姐的手。
这世间极少有真正的感同身受，但这一刻，她们两姐妹却是真的感同身受。
因为她们爱上同一个男人，然后同时失去丈夫，先后失去唯一的儿子。
虽然这些事镇北王妃并不完全清楚。
众人一同用过晚膳之后，段白语留了下来，白宣则跟着红袖和紫烟两个人前去他临时居住的院子。
他即将继承镇北王之位，继承他便宜老爹的一切。
自然也包括住所这些。
不过他老爹现在虽然死了，但到底还没下葬嘛，他也还不是镇北王，所以还是要等镇北王下葬了，一切都结束了，然后他再搬过去。
所以才有个临时院子。
“你们都是什么时候入王府的？在王府多少年了？”在路上，白宣问道。
content_en:
"Shi'an has just come back, and there are no smart maids around him. It's unreasonable to say it. Hongxiu and Ziyan have served me for many years, and they are very suitable. From now on, they will stay with An'er and serve An'er."
After the salute was completed, Princess Zhenbei looked at Bai Xuandao.
After the words fell, two maids walked out behind Princess Zhenbei.
One of them was dressed in black, and his skin was white and pink, smooth and crystal clear, like the finest mutton-fat white jade. He had his head bowed lightly, said nothing, and looked very docile.
One was dressed in purple, with curved eyebrows, and was petite, about five feet tall, but she had a good figure, was pretty and pretty, and had a different kind of contrast.
Bai Xuan took a curious look at the woman in black. The one in purple must be Zi Yan, but why isn't this red-sleeved woman wearing red?
However, this idea just emerged, and he immediately realized that King Zhenbei and his son had died one after another. If this maid dared to wear red at this time, she would be beaten to death with sticks. The thought passed by in a flash. Bai Xuan looked at Princess Zhenbei and said, "Thank you so much, ma'am."
Not to mention being the future King of Zhenbei, he is also the son of the Prince of Zhenbei, and he is surrounded by maids and servants.
Since he wants to pretend to be Xu Shian and be the King of Zhenbei, this kind of worldly experience is indispensable.
They look pretty good, and they are a pleasure to keep around.
Seeing that Bai Xuan agreed, Princess Zhenbei nodded with satisfaction, then looked at the two maids and said: "You two must serve the young master well."
"Yes."
The two maids, Hongxiu and Ziyan, both said yes and consciously stood behind Bai Xuan.
"My sister finally came back, why don't you sleep with me tonight." Princess Zhenbei looked at Duan Bai again and said.
"Tonight, I want to accompany Zhong Wen." Duan Baiyu declined after hearing this.
We haven't seen each other for many years, but when we meet again, we are separated forever.
The only good thing is that he went underground first.
This way An'er won't be bullied if she goes underground.
But if I had the choice, it would be great to be in the human world.
When Princess Zhenbei heard this, her expression changed slightly. She patted Duan Baiyu's hand and sighed, "Let's go together then. We will meet Zhongwen for the last time. An'er is back and it's time for Zhongwen's funeral."
They had known each other since King Zhenbei was not King of Zhenbei.
At that time, the King of Zhenbei was just a humble boy with nothing. When he met the two sisters by chance, he shouted, "If you are an official, you should be a Feiyuwei, and if you marry, you should be a daughter of the Duan family."
At that time, no one cared about him, they just thought he was a young man who spoke arrogantly.
But who would have thought that when the school offered wine and killed the king, the Great Zhou Dynasty was in civil strife, and the King of Zhenbei rose up in the wind, he really did it.
Marrying King Zhenbei, of course, there are family interests to consider, but more importantly, they all love King Zhenbei.
Duan Baiyu nodded and held his sister's hand with his backhand.
There is very little real empathy in this world, but at this moment, the two sisters really felt the same.
Because they fell in love with the same man, and then lost their husbands at the same time, and then lost their only son.
Although Princess Zhenbei is not completely clear about these things.
After everyone had dinner together, Duan Baiyu stayed, while Bai Xuan followed Hong Xiu and Zi Yan to the yard where he temporarily lived.
He is about to inherit the throne of Zhenbei King and inherit everything from his cheap father.
Naturally, this also includes residence.
However, although his father is dead now, he has not been buried yet. He is not the King of Zhenbei yet, so he still has to wait for the King of Zhenbei to be buried and everything is over before he can move there.
That’s why we have a temporary yard.
"When did you all join the palace? How many years have you been in the palace?" Bai Xuan asked on the way.
